items.title: Ralph Humphrey interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I just had the pleasure of attending a little clinic you did. [INTERVIEWEE] You were there, okay.

ctx.x: Ralph was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 11, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto at the IAJE convention filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton. I’m pleased to have Ralph Humphrey with me today. Our viewers won’t know it but I just had the pleasure of attending a little clinic you did.
